title: What if automating AI R&D triggers an intelligence explosion?
abstract: arXiv:2609.36054v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In contrast to even a year ago, AI systems now write most of the code inside the companies that build them. As more of the AI research and development (R&D) pipeline is automated, could AI progress radically accelerate in an "intelligence explosion," where years of advances are compressed into months or less? Preliminary evidence suggests that it could. In this work, we assess this evidence, analyze an intelligence explosion's potential impacts, and propose policy responses. AI systems are on track to automate most AI R\&D work within a few years, and possibly all of it. If this triggers an intelligence explosion, it could dramatically bring forward AI's benefits, but also pose extreme risks: capabilities growth could accelerate far beyond what society can keep up with, humanity could lose control over superhuman AI systems, and checks on power within and between states, companies, and branches of government could be severely eroded. translated_title: 如果AI研发自动化引发智能爆炸会怎样？
translated_abstract: 与一年前相比，如今AI系统已经编写了构建它们的公司内部的大部分代码。随着AI研发（R&D）流程中越来越多的环节被自动化，AI的进展是否可能在一场“智能爆炸”中急剧加速——将数年的进步压缩到数月甚至更短的时间内？初步证据表明这是可能的。在本工作中，我们评估了相关证据，分析了智能爆炸的潜在影响，并提出了政策应对方案。AI系统有望在几年内实现大部分AI研发工作的自动化，甚至可能是全部。如果这引发了智能爆炸，它可能极大地提前AI带来的好处，但也会带来极端风险：AI能力增长可能加速到远超社会所能跟上的程度，人类可能失去对超人AI系统的控制，并且国家内部与国家之间、公司之间以及政府各部门之间的权力制衡可能被严重削弱。
tldr: 本文评估了AI研发自动化可能在几年内触发“智能爆炸”的证据，指出这既会极大提前AI的收益，也会带来能力失控与权力制衡被侵蚀的极端风险，并据此提出政策应对建议。
en_tdlr: This paper assesses the evidence that automating AI R&D could trigger an "intelligence explosion" within a few years, analyzes how it could dramatically accelerate AI benefits while posing extreme risks—such as losing control of superhuman AI and eroding checks on power—and proposes corresponding policy responses.
